data.one_liner: Show achievement toasts in your Flutter application.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable toast-like widget to display game-like achievements or success messages on the screen. It supports custom icons, titles, subtitles, animations, and status listeners.
use_when: You want to display achievement unlocks or milestone notifications in a game or app.
You need a timed banner/toast overlay with custom animations and click listeners.
avoid_when: You need standard system push notifications or background notifications.
You require complex state-driven notification trays.
strengths: Easy to integrate and trigger imperatively via a show method.
Customizable appearance including icons, colors, shapes, and animations.
weaknesses: Limited to in-app visual toast banners.
Lacks advanced queuing out-of-the-box compared to dedicated toast management libraries.
data.setup_notes: No special native configuration or build_runner required.

alternatives.name: toastification
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a modern, highly customizable toast notification system with rich styling options.

alternatives.name: fluttertoast
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need basic native-style short toast messages across platforms.

alternatives.name: bot_toast
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a robust toast and overlay manager capable of handling complex overlay widgets.
